fusions.name: Belling
fusions.desc: Bells at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Startling Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps the water flat, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 20% chance to leave each one [Stunned] for 1 second. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Porpoising
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 6% for 6 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Far Hearing
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
